crossRefs.note: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint;’
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul…
I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! My heart is faint within me.

translations.web: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up;’
translations.bsb: If I were to say, ‘I will forget my complaint and change my expression and smile,’
translations.kjv: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort
translations.asv: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad countenance, and be of good cheer;
